item.title: Myanmar to hold by-elections in April, including in areas where fighting persists
item.description: Myanmar will hold special elections next April in its first vote since this year's general election that critics said was designed to cement military rule.

item.title: Turkey outlines plans for 'paradigm shift' in energy use ahead of climate summit
item.description: The Turkish energy minister has laid out plans for his country to wean itself away from coal and other fossil fuels as it prepares to host the COP31 climate change summit.

item.title: Malaysia's ex-premier Najib will serve prison time at home after paying $12.3 million for pardon
item.description: Malaysia’s former Prime Minister Najib Razak is set to leave prison for house arrest. His political party paid a 50 million ringgit fine required under his royal pardon.

item.title: 1 officer killed and 3 wounded in a firefight with a suspect in Lakewood, Colorado
item.description: Police say an officer in Lakewood, Colorado, has been killed and three others wounded during a firefight with a man who was fatally shot by police.

item.title: Data centers took a beating in the midterm elections. A reckoning may be ahead for tech giants
item.description: Opposition to data centers was part of midterm races across the U.S., with campaigns featuring them in hundreds of millions of dollars' worth of TV ads and many winners pledging to clamp down on the energy-hungry behemoths.
